title: It is not possible to add groupId in form mode.
body:
### version

last

### Link to minimal reproduction

_No response_

### Steps to reproduce

My scenario is as follows: my application has a permissions scheme that the user who created the document can configure for other users; they can edit or view in readonly mode, and they can also comment on the document.

My application starts in form mode by default, either directly through the options when instantiating or set via API right after creating the instance:
`instance.command.executeMode(EditorMode.FORM)`

Since the editor doesn't allow adding groupIds in readonly mode (I included readonly mode, form mode, etc.), I implemented the following scheme: in the menu registration, in the comments option, I removed the `when` rule that says the menu only appears if it's not readonly:

```
{
  name: '批注',
  when: payload => {
   return (
     // !payload.isReadonly &&
    payload.editorHasSelection &&
    payload.zone === EditorZone.MAIN
   )
 },
 ...
}
```

In the `onConfirm` event, I modified it so that before inserting the group, it switches to edit mode, and after performing all operations, it returns to form mode (or readonly):
```
onConfirm: payload => {
  const value = payload.find(p => p.name === 'value')?.value
  if (!value) return
  instance.command.executeMode(EditorMode.EDIT)
  instance.command.executeForceUpdate()
  const groupId = command.executeSetGroup()
  if (!groupId) return
  commentList.push({
    id: groupId,
    content: value,
    userName: 'Hufe',
    rangeText: command.getRangeText(),
    createdDate: new Date().toLocaleString()
  })
  instance.command.executeMode(EditorMode.FORM)
}
```

The editor remains in edit mode, but executeSetGroup() does not insert the groups, even if the editor remains in edit mode without returning to form mode as I did in the example, it still does not insert them.

### What is expected?

I would like a way for the document to be in form or read-only mode, and for the user viewing it to be able to insert comments if their permissions allow it.

### What is actually happening?

It's not possible to add groupId in form mode even if I explicitly change the mode to edit before trying to insert the groups.


title: 纵向合并单元格后，在合并的单元格回车光标无法到达底部，表格无限自动增大。Table auto-grows infinitely when cursor is placed in vertically merged cell
body:
### version

0.9.130

### Link to minimal reproduction

_No response_

### Steps to reproduce

新建一个表格（例如 5 行 × 3 列）
选中第一列所有单元格，执行合并操作（rowSpan = 5）
在合并后的单元格内回车，尝试将光标移动到底部
观察：表格高度持续增大，光标永远到不了合并单元格的底部

Select all cells in the first column and merge them (rowSpan = 5)
enter the merged cell and try to move the cursor toward the bottom
Observe: the table height keeps increasing, and the cursor never reaches the bottom of the merged cell

光标应该能够到达合并单元格的底部，表格高度应保持稳定，不应无限增长。

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8ebb143b-93a3-461b-95f5-64f9cdbc77bc)


### What is actually happening?

光标越往下移动，表格越高。形成正反馈循环：多余高度被加到 rowSpan 的最后一行，导致该行其他列的单元格也被撑高，产生更多空白区域，周而复始。

title: The cursor does not return to the first line position when the paragraph has more than one line.
body:
### version

last

### Link to minimal reproduction

_No response_

### Steps to reproduce

Open the demo, go to a paragraph that has more than one line, position the cursor at the beginning of the line (not necessarily on the first character). Then press the left arrow key to move the cursor back to the beginning of the line. When you reach the second character and try to return to the first character at the beginning of the line, the cursor will return to the previous line at the last position. Pressing the right arrow key to go to the first position of the line below will move the cursor to the second position.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d1c1aff9-c5f3-470b-87dc-43904bde3466

In paragraphs with more than one line, from the second line onwards, when navigating using the left arrow key, or the home key to go to the beginning of the line, the cursor returns to the first position of the line, and not to the second position as it usually does.

### What is actually happening?

This does not happen in paragraphs with only one line. The problem only occurs if it is an element with text that generates two or more lines. I also noticed that it only happens on the second line onwards. If you navigate in the first line of the paragraph, the cursor returns to the first character on the normal line. This also happens when navigating using the home key.

### What problem does this feature solve?

Currently, there's no native way to work with the Home and End keys on the keyboard. I tried using the existing API, but the only effect I achieved was setting the cursor to the beginning/end of the line like this:

```
  const ctx = editor.command.getRangeContext()
  editor.command.focus({ rowNo: ctx.startRowNo, position: 'before' })
  editor.command.focus({ rowNo: ctx.startRowNo, position: 'after' })
```

But I couldn't use getRangeContext in conjunction with executeSetRange to select the entire remaining part of the line, either to the left or right.

From what I understand, the rangeContext information isn't sufficient to set the selection to the beginning/end of the line.

I don't know if I'm not using the information correctly.

title: Group IDs are not exported and imported into HTML
body:
### version

last

### Link to minimal reproduction

_No response_

### Steps to reproduce

During testing, I noticed that the document's group IDs are not exported to HTML or imported into the editor elements.

I implemented a solution based on the HTML's `data-*` attribute; the group IDs are inserted into the `data-group-ids` attribute (with IDs separated by commas). Then I modified the reading function to retrieve these IDs, checking if the element has the `data-group-ids` attribute, and apply it to each created element.

I know that exporting and importing to HTML is a utility function and doesn't fully support the editor's native elements, but it was a simple alternative I found for this situation. This could also be used to add other attributes not supported in HTML.

I will open a PR (Request for Reference) if the author is interested in adding the change; I hope this helps.

NOTE: I noticed that inside the convertElementToDom function, the element type is being added via data-*:
```
if (element.type) {
  dom.setAttribute('data-type', element.type)
}
```
But this attribute is not read again when importing HTML. I might be wrong, but I think it's something that's left over.

### What is expected?

Exporting and importing groupId attributes in HTML.

### What is actually happening?

It doesn't export or import the groupId attribute.

title: Line spacing should scale proportionally with font size instead of using fixed pixel values
body: ### version 0.9.122 ### Link to minimal reproduction https://hufe.club/canvas-editor/ ### Steps to reproduce **Current Behavior:** The editor uses a **fixed pixel-based line spacing** (`defaultBasicRowMarginHeight`) regardless of font size. This creates inconsistent visual appearance: - Small fonts (8px) appear too spaced out - Large fonts (24px) appear cramped - Inconsistent reading experience across different font sizes **Steps to Reproduce:** 1. Open - https://hufe.club/canvas-editor/ 2. Type text with default font size (8px) - notice the line spacing 3. Change font size to 28px - notice the line spacing remains almost the same in pixels 4. Change font size to 12px - notice excessive spacing relative to text size 5. Compare with Google Docs or Microsoft Word with the same font sizes - notice they use proportional spacing ### What is expected? Line spacing should scale **proportionally** with font size, following industry standards: - **Google Docs**: Uses `lineHeight = 1.15 × fontSize` by default - **Microsoft Word**: Uses `lineHeight = 1.15-1.2 × fontSize` - **CSS Standard**: `line-height: 1.15` (relative to font size) **This ensures:** - Natural, readable spacing for all font sizes - Consistent proportions across different text sizes - Better readability for multilingual content (English, Arabic, Chinese, etc.) - User can still control spacing via existing `rowMargin` multiplier (1-3x) **Google Docs Example:** -- ### What is actually happening? **Problem:** - `defaultBasicRowMarginHeight` is a **fixed pixel value** from options (e.g., 1px) - Same margin applied to ALL font sizes: 12px, 24px, 48px, etc. - Results in: - Large text appearing cramped (1px margin for 48px text = 2% spacing) - Small text appearing loose (1px margin for 12px text = 8% spacing) **Canvas Editor Spacing:** ### Editor Value ```json ``` ### System Info ```shell ``` ### Any additional comments? _No response_

title: Layout shift when inserting Tab character - Y position adjustment causes visual misalignment
body:
### version

0.9.122

### Link to minimal reproduction

https://hufe.club/canvas-editor/

### Steps to reproduce


**Steps to Reproduce**
1. Open the canvas editor (https://hufe.club/canvas-editor/)
2. Type some text in English (e.g., "Hello World")
3. Position the cursor in the middle/end of the text
4. Press the **Tab** key
5. Observe: The line shifts down slightly as the tab is inserted


Affected Environments
- All browsers
- All languages (especially noticeable with mixed-language content like Chinese + English)


### What is expected?


**Expected Behavior**
No visual layout shift when inserting Tab. The line should maintain its Y position, and the tab should align with the baseline of surrounding text.

### What is actually happening?


**Problem Analysis**
In  `https://github.com/Hufe921/canvas-editor/blob/30dea59ea57115dac7e23c0a5cfe46522e703a60/src/editor/core/draw/particle/TextParticle.ts#L88` , the Tab element measurement returns:

```typescript
actualBoundingBoxAscent: textMetrics.actualBoundingBoxAscent,  // From space ' '
actualBoundingBoxDescent: textMetrics.actualBoundingBoxDescent  // From space ' '
```

The space character's metrics don't represent the full font capabilities, causing:
- CJK characters with different metrics to cause misalignment
- Mixed font sizes to trigger unnecessary recalculation

title: Allow fullscreen and YouTube redirection for embedded YouTube videos
body:
### What problem does this feature solve?

Currently, **embedded YouTube videos** added via iframe in the editor come with a restrictive `sandbox` (`allow-scripts allow-same-origin`), which prevents users from:

1. Watching the video in fullscreen directly in the editor.
2. Opening the video in a new tab or redirecting to YouTube using a pop-up.

This limitation negatively impacts the user experience, especially when a more immersive viewing or native YouTube functionality is desired.

### What does the proposed API look like?

I suggest allowing the iframe creation to accept additional options, such as:

```
{
  src: string,
  height?: number,
  width?: number,
  allowFullscreen?: boolean,  // Enables fullscreen
  allowPopup?: boolean        // Allows opening in a new tab or redirecting to YouTube
}
```
With `allowFullscreen: true` and `allowPopup: true`, the iframe could include the necessary attributes (`allowfullscreen` and `allow-presentation`) to enable fullscreen and YouTube redirection.
regression_note: 已补充 Cypress 回归：iframe block 默认包含 fullscreen、picture-in-picture、popup 和用户触发顶层跳转所需权限。

title: Question: How to get the ID of images inserted via executeInsertElementList?
body: ### What problem does this feature solve? I'm inserting images into the editor using `executeInsertElementList`, like this: ``` window.editor_canvas.command.executeInsertElementList([ { type: "image", value: "/path/to/image.jpg", width: 100, height: 100, extension: { name: item.name, type: item.type, value: item.id, } } ]); ``` The image renders fine, but I want to delete it later programmatically using: `window.editor_canvas.command.executeDeleteElementById({ id }); ` The problem is that `executeInsertElementList` doesn't expose or return the **internally generated** `id` for the inserted image. Using `getValue() `shows an id, but it's not recognized by `executeDeleteElementById`. Likewise, `getHTML()` does not output any useful `id` on `` tags. The only way I've found to get the correct id is to **manually select the image** and access `getRangeContext().startElement.id.` ### What does the proposed API look like? Some ideas: 1 - Have `executeInsertElementList` **return the** **id**s of inserted elements: ``` const ids = window.editor_canvas.command.executeInsertElementList([...]); console.log(ids); // ['uuid-1234'] ``` 2 - Provide a method like: `window.editor_canvas.command.getAllElementsByType('image')` ...that returns all rendered images with their real **id**s. 3 - Or, update `getHTML()` to include `data-id` attributes on rendered images: `` `That would enable us to search and manipulate elements by id later.`

title: API to get the height of elements and the height of the current page content
body: ### What problem does this feature solve? Hello, I needed to implement two methods to get the height of elements and internal content. The usage scenario was as follows: I have a set of elements that will be added in stages, which can be text, tables, lists, etc. Let's assume they are only tables, and the content of these tables varies greatly (it's loaded from a database). I'll add the tables one after the other while the page has enough space. If the remaining space is insufficient, I'll add a page break, and I'll insert the next tables on the remaining pages. Page with table with broken content Page with page break ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4739095e-781f-42fd-b97c-163d084f2b76) ### What does the proposed API look like? After adding each table, I calculate the height of the next table. I also need to know the size of the remaining space on the page to check whether the table to be inserted will fit on the current page. If the table is larger than the remaining space on the page, I'll insert a page break and add the table to the next page. This way, I can control whether parts of the content are cut off and are displayed in their entirety. Of course, if a table is larger than a page, I'll let it "cut" because there's nothing else to do. I'd like to know if the author might find these implementations useful for the project. It's not quite a paragraph control, but it allows the developer to control the display of their content if desired. There are two methods implemented, both with approximately 30 lines each: getHeightElementList(elementList: IElement[]) and getInternalHeightsPages(rowList?: IRow[]). I copied parts of the computePageList() and computeRowList() methods for this. Would you like me to submit a PR for review?

title: Ability to add custom properties to image elements and retrieve them via getValue()
body:
### What problem does this feature solve?

Currently, it is not possible to associate custom metadata with image elements in `canvas-editor.` This limits use cases where it is necessary to identify, classify, or link additional information to inserted images (e.g., internal system IDs, tags, or external references).

Being able to retrieve these custom values via `getValue()` would make integrations and data persistence much easier, without relying on DOM hacks or external storage.

Is there currently any way to:

- Add custom properties to image elements (or other elements)?
- Retrieve these properties through getValue() (or any other method)?

If not, are there plans to add support for this in future versions?

Thanks!

### What does the proposed API look like?

The API could allow custom properties to be included in the object passed to `executeImage()` (and potentially other commands).

Example:

```
instance.command.executeImage({
  width: 100,
  height: 100,
  value: "example.png",
  customTag: "myExtraValue",
  anotherMeta: "anyOtherValue"
});
```
And getValue() would return:

```
[
  {
    width: 100,
    height: 100,
    value: "example.png",
    customTag: "myExtraValue",
    anotherMeta: "anyOtherValue"
  }
]
```

title: Support for Paragraph Spacing (Before & After)
body:
### What problem does this feature solve?

Currently, there's no support for customizing spacing before or after a paragraph. This leads to content blocks appearing too close together, which affects readability and formatting control. This feature solves:

Adding space before a paragraph (e.g., for visual separation from the previous element).

Adding space after a paragraph (e.g., to separate it from the next content block).

### What does the proposed API look like?

paragraphSpacingBefore?: number; // in px or pt
paragraphSpacingAfter?: number;  // in px or pt

paragraphSpacingBefore: 12,
paragraphSpacingAfter: 8


When computing layout (e.g., computeRowList or drawRow), insert additional vertical spacing:

spacingBefore is applied before rendering the row if it's the start of a paragraph.

spacingAfter is added as bottom margin after the last row of the paragraph.

title: Dynamic and Consistent Translation for Link Editing Prompt
body:
### What problem does this feature solve?

Currently, when editing a hyperlink in the editor, the text displayed in the prompt is fixed in Chinese ("\u7F16\u8F91\u94FE\u63A5"). This can make it difficult to understand for users who use other languages. It would be interesting if this message were displayed dynamically according to the language selected in the application, as it already happens in other parts of the editor. Additionally, it would be positive if the message shown in the prompt were the same as the one presented on the "edit hyperlink" button when right-clicking on a hyperlink, ensuring a more consistent and user-friendly experience.

### What does the proposed API look like?

The suggestion is that the text of the link editing prompt be obtained dynamically, according to the language selected by the user, using the same text present on the "edit hyperlink" button of the context menu. For example:

`window.prompt(/* dynamic message, identical to the edit hyperlink button */, context.startElement?.url);`

This way, the message will be displayed correctly in the user's language and consistently throughout the interface.

title: 标题支持序号，有序列表支持回车填充内容保证序号正确
body:
### What problem does this feature solve?

1：标题支持自动添加序号，比如1级标题的序号是数字，二级标题的序号是小写字母，三级标题的序号是大写字母等等；
2：标题内容缩进，例如一级标题缩进10px，二级标题缩进20px，依此类推，标题下的所有内容的宽度按照(100%-标题缩进的px),然后给内容设置flex='right'居右；
3：有序列表中添加内容可以保持有序列表正常显示，目前在中间加内容会导致加内容之后的有序列表会从1开始计数，实现类似word的有序列表编辑；
4：获取点击内容范围的属性进行修改，这个需求可以理解为自动生成表单功能的点击表单组件然后右侧面板可以显示组件的属性并进行修改。

title: 控件隐藏问题
body:
### What problem does this feature solve?

1、使用hide将控件隐藏之后如果控件是禁止删除的会有一个问题，比如内容：111{隐藏控件}222，控件隐藏了，通过光标从最后删除，将222删除后到达控件位置就删除不了了，这会让用户感觉到删除无效了，实际上是被隐藏的禁止删除控件给阻挡，因为控件禁止了删除，能在原始代码中判断如果删除到隐藏控件则光标往前跳，直到能正常删除。

2、怎么满足多个控件捆绑式的显示和隐藏，就是控件组的概念；area中好像可以包含多个控件，是否area能不能增加一个hide来控制区域的显示隐藏（area的position属性怎么使用？）

### What does the proposed API look like?

在原始代码中判断如果删除到隐藏控件则光标往前跳，直到能正常删除。

title: Add footnote
body:
### What problem does this feature solve?

Adds footnotes for supplementary information with automatic numbering and interactive scrolling for easy navigation between references and footnotes
![footnotes](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/74529a28-af41-4aad-a0e4-680f5fe18e20)


### What does the proposed API look like?

Footnote Insertion: Allow users to insert footnotes at any point in the document. Each footnote will be automatically numbered or labeled with a symbol.

Automatic Numbering: Footnotes will be automatically numbered sequentially, and the numbering will update if footnotes are added or removed.

Footnote Display: Footnotes will be displayed at the bottom of the page or section where they are referenced, with a line separating the main content from the footnotes.

Editable Footnotes: Users can edit the text of footnotes, which will be updated automatically in all references throughout the document.

Formatting Options: Provide basic formatting options for footnotes, including font size and style adjustments.

Interactive Scrolling: Implement interactive scrolling for footnotes:

Click on Footnote Number: When a user clicks on a footnote number in the main text, the view will automatically scroll to the corresponding footnote text at the bottom of the page or section.
Click on Footnote Text: Conversely, when a user clicks on a footnote text at the bottom of the page or section, the view will scroll to the location in the main content where the footnote was referenced.

title: 增加表格行线拖拽功能
body:
### What problem does this feature solve?

在canvas-editor当做模板来使用渲染的时候，某种场景下
1.每一个表格的整体高度不能改变，会使用到表格单元格行拖拽和列拖拽一样改变相邻单元格的大小，不改变整体表格的高度
2.在这种场景下，表格整体高度不能变动，并且在渲染中单元格的行高不随着内容的高度变化
以上两个需求我在使用中遇到的，已经有代码实现，如果合理我可以提交pr

### What does the proposed API look like?

通过单元格配置的方式，可以达到拖拽单元格行线改变相邻行的高度，不改变整体高度，并且行高不随着单元格内容的增加而改变高度

title: Add paragraph spacing options
body:
### What problem does this feature solve?

The existing program solely permits adjustments to line spacing. By incorporating paragraph spacing options, users gain enhanced document formatting capabilities, leading to heightened readability and improved presentation.
![Picture1](https://github.com/Hufe921/canvas-editor/assets/75673766/37ac37e3-2dc9-4a6d-97bf-027ddb8f3d2d)

Additionally, it would be beneficial to have the flexibility to change units within the program. While the default unit appears to be pixels (px), offering the option to switch to points (pt) or other units would greatly enhance user convenience and adaptability to diverse formatting preferences.

### What does the proposed API look like?

The proposed API would add two new properties to the Paragraph class: BeforeSpacing AfterSpacing
These properties would allow users to specify the amount of space before and after each paragraph.

title: 优化 RTL 时，range 范围的获取方案
body: ### version 0.9.69 ### Link to minimal reproduction _No response_ ### Steps to reproduce #469 相关 对已完成的渲染效果来说，underline 和 strikeout 是正确绘制的，其差别在于绘制的实际坐标在重排之后进行了重新计算。 可参考下面的实现： ```ts this.textRenderQueue = result.map((r, idx) => { const x = startX - offsetX // TODO 赋值 rtlPositions, 方便进行后续取值 const res = { ...r, positions: r.positions.map(p => ({ ...p, rtlCoordinate: { leftTop: [x, p.coordinate.leftTop[1]], leftBottom: [x, p.coordinate.leftBottom[1]], rightTop: [x + r.width[idx], p.coordinate.rightTop[1]], rightBottom: [x + r.width[idx], p.coordinate.rightBottom[1]] } })), x } as ITextRenderItem offsetX += r.width.reduce((prev, curr) => { return prev + curr }) return res }) ``` 在完成重排之后，会根据 position 的指针修改新增的 `rtlCoordinate` 属性。直接修改之前的 `coordinate` 属性，会导致原始位置丢失，触发重新渲染的时候坐标错误，因此已经被证实不可行了。 但这同时也带来了新的问题，range manager 只设置索引的动作并不完全正确，因为文本重排导致了绘制坐标发生了整体的改变。因此 range 的确认靠索引来实现是存在不合理的，尤其是 rtl 和 ltr 混排的时候，存在一左一右的问题，无法确定实际的选区范围。 ### What is expected? 目前想到的解决方案是，通过鼠标 y 来计算出实际的行号，获取 rowElements 之后，再根据重排之后的 x 坐标和鼠标偏移坐标，确定实际的选区范围。选区需要记录的是 position 指针，而非索引 ### What is actually happening? 在 RTL 新的文本绘制方案下，错误的选区范围会导致 range 依赖的富文本格式绘制错误，相应 command 无法进行正常工作 #468 ### System Info _No response_ ### Any additional comments? _No response_

文本绘制方案改为了 **按行绘制**，而不是 **按元素绘制**

整体绘制方案改为 **按行绘制**，而非 **按元素绘制**，否则在单行文本渲染时，会导致不正确的 underline 等坐标的记录，这部分需要进行重构。

按行计算出正确的样式坐标，然后在行结束对整行进行绘制

title: Date 渲染存在缺陷

labels.name: duplicate
labels.description: This issue or pull request already exists

body:
### version

0.9.97

### Link to minimal reproduction

_No response_

### Steps to reproduce

默认 date 的渲染逻辑为每个字符进行一个个单字渲染，这会对 rtl 情况下的渲染造成困扰，改为类 LaTeX 或者字符串整体渲染会更好

### What is expected?

将 date 选择作为整体渲染，在渲染逻辑和坐标计算上，这种方式存在逻辑问题。

- 单字符坐标计算存在问题

`ctx.direction='rtl'` 情况下的文本的绘制会自动根据文字进行计算顺序，但其计算坐标仍为 LeftTop 点坐标，渲染逻辑为坐标轴对称，如果整体修改 positionList 的话会导致渲染错误

- Date 单字符绘制存在问题

如上所述，`2000-01-01 10:10:10` 作为一个整体在逻辑上无论是 rtl 还是 ltr 默认渲染为 `2000-01-01 10:10:10`。其原因在于作为一个整体，其中不存在 RTL 字符，所以不存在倒向渲染的问题。

一旦变成单字符绘制之后，rtl 渲染结果就变成了 `01:01:01 10-10-0002` ，这种方式是不正确的

- 单字符绘制逻辑存在问题

原则上来说，Date 是一个整体，如果进行类文本输入的话，会造成删除部分仍为 Date 类型的逻辑错误问题。直接使用 DatePicker 是个相对来说不错的主意，Date 数据应该是由 DatePicker 设置的单向不可变的。

### What is actually happening?

将 date 作为整体渲染，个人更倾向于 canvas 字符串的方式，这样可以直接把 RTL 渲染的逻辑扔给浏览器自行进行处理解决。

渲染成图片的方式不算是一个好的解决方案，虽然跟字符串的逻辑一样，在默认上就是强制 LTR 的

### System Info

_No response_

### Any additional comments?

title: 希望可以增加判断是否被编辑、记录下编辑内容、页面脚本、每页出现功能
body:
### What problem does this feature solve?

作者您好，canvas-editor是一个很好的富媒体文本编辑器。
在产品文档查阅和开发过程中，发现找不到类似的接口实现以下功能：

1、判断这次加载的文件是否被编辑过
2、记录哪些内容被删除、修改、新增
3、数据加载进来后执行页面样式处理脚本
4、段落、行、表格，每页重复出现

关于第一点需求，具体应用场景描述：
在用户加载进来这批数据后，能够监听页面上数据的变动，当用户修改时记录成已修改，如果修改后又还原成了原本的样式。那么这时候可以重新记录成未修改，这时候需要做加载前数据与加载后所修改数据进行比对。

关于第二点需求，具体应用场景描述
用户记录下用户修改数据，
如果是在行、段落、单元格内删除内容，并重新输入新的内容这时候可以记录下修改前是什么内容，修改后是什么内容；
如果是删除后未在该行、段落、单元格新增内容，记录为删除；
如果是在空白行、段落、单元格新增内容，记录为新增。

关于第三点需求，具体应用场景描述
数据加载进来后，需要再对页面进行二次处理，比如根据某些逻辑条件标注数据颜色、自动向上合并或向右合并单元格、根据某些条件自动输出不同的表格模版。不一定需要通过代码脚本实现，也可以通过占位符的方式实现类似功能。
其他产品实现方式：
以下是docx-templates这个库实现的方式
https://github.com/guigrpa/docx-templates

![image](https://github.com/Hufe921/canvas-editor/assets/12406935/954a12b2-1eef-4f18-b470-964794ee6269)
![image](https://github.com/Hufe921/canvas-editor/assets/12406935/bf2810ff-2acb-4271-91ab-369374990e87)


http://guigrpa.github.io/2017/01/01/word-docs-the-relay-way/
![image](https://github.com/Hufe921/canvas-editor/assets/12406935/6ffb1923-7ae6-4ab2-a8e6-ddd590e11e0c)
![image](https://github.com/Hufe921/canvas-editor/assets/12406935/32641e33-132a-4b8d-8842-f97deaac5c41)

关于第四点需求，具体应用场景描述
能对行、段落、表格，设置换页后可重复出现在不同页，比如以下案例，header、footer是重复固定段落，data是数据行。data数据不固定，如果data数据过多导致换页，header、footer换页后重复显示。
![image](https://github.com/Hufe921/canvas-editor/assets/12406935/f99af614-936f-4f17-b7f4-939f41edec0b)

title: Page numbering setup suggestion
body:
### What problem does this feature solve?

Hi, I saw that the page number setting options were improved which looks great.

I would like to suggest the implementation of some more configuration possibilities, which can make the editor more robust and flexible, are the following:

- Option to configure where the pagination should appear header or footer. It is currently fixed to the footer;
- Option to configure from which page the pagination should start, ex: from page 2, then page 1 would not display number.
- Option to define exceptions where the page number should NOT appear, eg page 5, 6, 7; then the editor would show the number on all pages except those reported.

The last two suggestions could also be applied to setting up the header/footer. From which page the header/footer can be displayed, or which pages the header/footer will NOT be displayed.

### What does the proposed API look like?

I imagine these settings could be defined in the editor's configuration, in the 'pageNumber' property, and applied when the editor is rendering the pages.

I don't know if it's easy to implement, and if you're interested in these proposals. I believe that the editor will meet the most diverse scenarios with these additional settings.

Again congratulations on the project. Hugs.
